text: The purpose of this report is to provide Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors with an update on the advancement of key policy initiatives, programs and projects impacting Toronto Parking Authority. The status of Toronto Parking Authority facilities that have been identified for city building opportunities and initiatives or which are otherwise being redeveloped through joint venture projects is also provided. Further updates about city building activities involving Toronto Parking Authority facilities will continue to be provided to the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors on a semi-annual basis. Updates about the City-Wide Parking Strategy and the Parking Portfolio Review will be provided as the work continues to progress.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (September 21, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 21, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, remain confidential in its entirety, as it deals with a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the City of Toronto.
